email_confirm.subject: %[1]s, please confirm your email address
email_confirm.confirm: Confirm your email address with the link below and you are set.

changed.subject: Your ONE password was changed
changed.warning: If that was not you, someone else has access to your account. Contact your administrator now.

reset.subject: Reset your ONE password
reset.instructions: Use the link below to set a new password.

invalid.subject: Someone tried to sign in to your ONE account and failed
invalid.message: Someone signed in with your username and password but got the two-factor code wrong.
invalid.warning: **If that was not you, someone else knows your password. Change it now.**

account_locked.subject: We have locked your ONE account
account_locked.message: Someone signed in with your password but could not produce a valid two-factor code.
account_locked.disabled: After 10 failed attempts we locked your account and reset your password. The reset email we just sent has the link to set a new one.
account_locked.reset_instructions: If that email has not arrived, you can request another at [%[1]s](%[2]s).

failed.subject: Someone tried to sign in to your ONE account with the wrong password
failed.message: Someone tried your account with a wrong password three times in a row.
failed.warning: If that was not you, someone may be trying to get into your account.
failed.enhance_security: A stronger password or two-factor authentication would close that off. Both are in your settings:

confirm.subject: Please confirm you want your ONE account deleted
confirm.request: You asked us to delete your account. Confirm it with the link below.
confirm.schedule_info: Once you confirm, we will delete your account in three days and email you again before then.
confirm.consequences: Deleting your account removes every project and task you created. Anything you shared with another person or team transfers to them.
confirm.changed_mind: If you did not ask for this, or you have changed your mind, ignore this email.

scheduled.subject_days: Your ONE account will be deleted in %[1]s days
scheduled.subject_tomorrow: Your ONE account will be deleted tomorrow
scheduled.request_reminder: You asked us to delete your ONE account.
scheduled.deletion_time_days: We will delete it in %[1]s days.
scheduled.changed_mind: If you have changed your mind, use the link below to cancel and follow the instructions there.

completed.subject: Your ONE account has been deleted
completed.confirmation: As you asked, we have deleted your ONE account.
completed.permanent: This is permanent. If you need the data back and have no backup, talk to your administrator.

comment.subject: Re: %[1]s (%[2]s)
comment.mentioned_subject: %[1]s mentioned you in a comment in "%[2]s" (%[3]s)

assigned.subject_to_others_self: "%[1]s" (%[2]s) has been assigned by %[3]s to themselves
assigned.message_to_others_self: %[1]s has assigned this task to themselves.

mentioned.subject_new: %[1]s mentioned you in a new task "%[2]s" (%[3]s)
mentioned.subject: %[1]s mentioned you in a task "%[2]s" (%[3]s)

overdue.subject: Task "%[1]s" (%[2]s) is overdue
overdue.message: A reminder about the task "%[1]s" (%[2]s). It has been overdue %[3]s and is not done.

member_added.subject: %[1]s added you to the "%[2]s" team
member_added.message: %[1]s just added you to the %[2]s team.

ready.subject: Your ONE data export is ready
ready.message: Your data export is ready. The button below downloads it.
ready.availability: The download works for the next 7 days.

done.subject: The migration from %[1]s to ONE is done
done.imported: ONE has imported every project, task, note, reminder and file you had access to on %[1]s.
done.have_fun: Your projects are waiting for you.

failed.subject: The migration from %[1]s to ONE failed
failed.message: The move from %[1]s did not go through this time.
failed.retry: Starting it again the same way usually works. These often come down to something on %[1]s's side that has since cleared.
failed.report: Tell us about it [in the tracker](https://github.com/BraznMngo/brazn-tasks/issues) so we can look at why it failed.
failed.working_on_it: We have the error and we are working on it.

week.subject: Your API token "%[1]s" expires soon
week.message: Your API token "%[1]s" expires on %[2]s. Create a new one before then if you still need it.

day.subject: Your API token "%[1]s" expires tomorrow
day.message: Your API token "%[1]s" expires on %[2]s. Create a new one before then if you still need it.

actions.confirm_account_deletion: Confirm the deletion of my account
actions.change_notification_settings_link: You can change your notification settings [here](%[1]s).
